correctness.rationale: The precise objective is max_p lambda_min(C^(1/2) diag(p) C^(1/2)) for a unit-diagonal SPD 3x3 correlation C with a,b,c>0 and p on the probability simplex. Its reciprocal minimization over w>0, C-diag(w) positive semidefinite, has a unique optimizer from strict convexity and Slater. KKT gives Z>=0 with Z_ii=1/w_i^2 and MZ=0. Since M nonzero singular with positive off-diagonal entries, rank M is one or two. Rank-one M=rr^T forces r_i^2=ab/c,ac/b,bc/a and the triangle/Heron condition on lengths r_i/w_i; rank-two M forces a rank-one Z=vv^T, Cv=s, and the three sign vectors. The two ranks exhaust the exact global KKT candidates and all boundaries. Exact rational witness formulas in both branches agree with submitted rational verifier logic. The proof is universal; 1000-point grid is only supplementary.
